sn2.27:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Nando devaputto Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn2.27:2.1: Accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo || vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti || etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno puññāni kayirātha sukhāvahānīti || ||
